text:
I don't know. The series dates to the 1890s, but I have no reliable record of attendance for the first game, and early games often have no recorded figure at all. I won't guess a number.

Syracuse's media guide or football archives, Colgate's athletics history pages, or contemporary newspaper coverage (e.g., the *Syracuse Post-Standard* via Fultonhistory.com or NYS Historic Newspapers) are the places most likely to have it.
